name: Freaky Frida
bio: Smiles at everyone. Nobody has seen her blink.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model: the owner made her in Meshy (owner, 2026-11-18: "i created her with meshy") and rigged her there (the download "freaky frida rigged", 2026-11-01, Meshy's "All Animations" export: 10,760 triangles, a 24-joint Mixamo skeleton with its own skin weights, Running and Walking clips not used). A wide-eyed girl in pigtails, a tactical vest and camouflage shorts. Re-imported 2026-11-19 from that rigged download with its own weights (owner, 2026-11-18: her back shoulders still tore in the hold): until then she was built from the unrigged "freaky frida lowpoly" download, rigged here from hand-set T-pose landmarks, with `armCloth` and six `plugs` closing the see-through armholes; the shoulders still stretched and opened from behind in the hold. No finger chains in the rig, so hands.mjs re-fits the fingers.
